_doc.zh: FACS 动作单元（AU）到肌肉通道的对应。疼痛用的 11 个 AU（UNBC-McMaster 库编码的，见 egede2017）之外，另有表情用的 AU1、2、5、14、15、16、17、23、24（肌肉基础见 cmu-facs）。AU11、13、18、22、28 也已加入（见各条的说明）；下颌前伸和侧移没有对应的 AU 条目。channels 的键是 muscles.json 里的肌肉 id（两侧同时激活），值是 AU 强度为 5（E 级，最大）时该肌肉的激活。AU 的名称和肌肉基础取自 wikipedia-facs；权重的具体数值、以及“强度 0–5 与位移成正比”都是本项目的假设（FACS 的强度是序数等级，不是位移量）。jawFraction 是强度为 5 时下颌张开角占颞下颌关节活动范围的比例，也是假设。 oral_recess 不是肌肉：它是皮肤上口裂内陷的几何替代（皮肤没有口裂），权重是假设。 mouth_corner 也不是肌肉：皮肤有真实口裂时用它把张开的口角修成杏仁形，权重等于该 AU 的 jawFraction。oral_recess 只用于闭合的皮肤，mouth_corner 只用于开口的皮肤。
_doc.en: FACS action units (AUs) as combinations of muscle channels. Besides the 11 AUs used for pain (those coded by the UNBC-McMaster archive, see egede2017) there are AU1, 2, 5, 14, 15, 16, 17, 23 and 24 for expressions (muscular basis per cmu-facs). AU11, 13, 18, 22 and 28 are included too (see each entry); jaw protrusion and lateral movement have no AU entry. Keys of `channels` are muscle ids from muscles.json (both sides activate together); values are the muscle's activation at AU intensity 5 (level E, maximum). AU names and muscular basis come from wikipedia-facs; the weight values, and the proportionality of displacement to intensity 0–5, are assumptions of this project (FACS intensities are ordinal grades, not displacements). `jawFraction` is the jaw opening at intensity 5 as a fraction of the temporomandibular range of motion, also an assumption. oral_recess is not a muscle: it is the geometric stand-in for the oral fissure on the skin (which has no opening); its weights are assumptions. mouth_corner is not a muscle either: with a real oral fissure it shapes the opened mouth corners into an almond, and its weight equals the AU's jawFraction. oral_recess applies to a closed skin only and mouth_corner to an opened one only.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：额肌内侧部。内外侧的分界是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: frontalis, pars medialis. Where medial ends and lateral begins is an assumption.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：额肌外侧部。
note.en: Muscular basis: frontalis, pars lateralis.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：皱眉肌、降眉肌（cmu-facs 的 1978 年版表）；维基百科的表另列降眉间肌（depressor glabellae，即 procerus）。模型里没有降眉肌。降眉间肌的权重 1 是本项目的建模选择（它把眉内侧端下拉），不是有出处的“肌肉基础”——是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: corrugator supercilii, depressor supercilii (the 1978 table at cmu-facs); Wikipedia's table adds depressor glabellae (procerus). The model has no depressor supercilii. The weight of 1 for procerus is a modelling choice of this project (it draws the inner brow down), not a sourced muscular basis — an assumption.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：上睑提肌。实现为上睑缘沿眼球上移（见 muscles.json），只在有真实睑裂的皮肤上有。
note.en: Muscular basis: levator palpebrae superioris. Implemented as the upper lid margin rising along the globe (see muscles.json), only on a skin with a real fissure.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：眼轮匝肌眶部。下睑随颊部被推高的 0.4 是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: orbicularis oculi, pars orbitalis. The 0.4 for the lower lid being pushed up with the cheek is an assumption.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：眼轮匝肌睑部。上睑下落 0.35（睑裂变窄而不闭合）是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: orbicularis oculi, pars palpebralis. The 0.35 of upper-lid lowering (a narrowed, not closed, eye) is an assumption.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：提上唇鼻翼肌。皱鼻时眉内侧端同时被拉低，这里用降眉间肌 0.5 表示；这个 0.5 是假设（FACS 手册未打开）。
note.en: Muscular basis: levator labii superioris alaeque nasi. Wrinkling the nose also draws the inner ends of the brows down, represented here by procerus at 0.5; that 0.5 is an assumption (the FACS manual was not opened).

note.zh: 肌肉基础：提上唇肌（眶下头）。
note.en: Muscular basis: levator labii superioris, caput infraorbitalis.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：颧小肌（cmu-facs 的表）。只用这一块肌肉全激活；鼻唇沟本身由皱纹层表现。
note.en: Muscular basis: zygomaticus minor (the table at cmu-facs). Just that muscle at full activation; the furrow itself is shown by the wrinkle layer.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：颧大肌。
note.en: Muscular basis: zygomaticus major.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：提口角肌（cmu-facs 的表把 AU13 写作 Cheek Puffer，肌肉为 levator anguli oris）。名称“sharp lip puller”没有核对到出处。
note.en: Muscular basis: levator anguli oris (the table at cmu-facs lists AU13 as "Cheek Puffer" with that muscle). The name "sharp lip puller" was not verified against a source.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：颊肌。
note.en: Muscular basis: buccinator.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：降口角肌。
note.en: Muscular basis: depressor anguli oris.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：降下唇肌。
note.en: Muscular basis: depressor labii inferioris.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：颏肌。
note.en: Muscular basis: mentalis.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：上、下唇切牙肌（cmu-facs 的表）；模型里没有这两块肌肉，用口轮匝肌的环形缩窄加唇前突代替。权重是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: incisivus labii superioris and inferioris (the table at cmu-facs); the model has neither, so the ring narrowing of orbicularis oris plus lip protrusion stands in. Weights are assumptions.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：笑肌，颈阔肌协同。颈阔肌的 0.5 是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: risorius with platysma. The 0.5 for platysma is an assumption.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：口轮匝肌（cmu-facs 的表）。实现为唇前突、少量缩窄、两唇分开；没有做唇外翻。权重是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: orbicularis oris (the table at cmu-facs). Realised as protrusion, a little narrowing and parted lips; no eversion of the lips is modelled. Weights are assumptions.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：口轮匝肌。收紧 = 唇缘向内卷、红唇变窄（lip_roll 0.7）加一半的环形缩窄；与 AU24（压紧 = 红唇上下压扁）在几何上不同。权重是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: orbicularis oris. Tightening = the margins roll in and the vermilion narrows (lip_roll at 0.7) plus half of the ring narrowing; geometrically distinct from AU24 (pressing = the vermilion flattened vertically). Weights are assumptions.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：口轮匝肌。压紧 = 两唇互相压、红唇上下压扁（lip_press），加少量环形缩窄和颏肌（下唇上顶）；权重是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: orbicularis oris. Pressing = the lips pushed against each other and the vermilion flattened vertically (lip_press), with a little ring narrowing and mentalis (the lower lip pushed up); weights are assumptions.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：降下唇肌，或颏肌、口轮匝肌放松。这里用降下唇肌 0.6 加提上唇肌 0.15（两唇都离开口裂）；两个数是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: depressor labii inferioris, or relaxation of mentalis or orbicularis oris. Here depressor labii inferioris at 0.6 plus levator labii superioris at 0.15 (both lips leave the fissure); both numbers are assumptions.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：咬肌；颞肌和翼内肌放松。表现为颞下颌关节张开；jawFraction 0.35 和降下唇肌 0.3 是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: masseter; relaxed temporalis and internal pterygoid. Realised as opening of the temporomandibular joint; jawFraction 0.35 and the 0.3 of the lip depressor are assumptions.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：翼肌、二腹肌。表现为颞下颌关节张到活动范围的上限；降下唇肌 0.5 是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: pterygoids, digastric. Realised as the temporomandibular joint opened to the end of its range; the 0.5 of the lip depressor is an assumption.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：口轮匝肌（cmu-facs 的表）。实现为两唇缘内卷加压扁，下颌略开；唇没有真的卷过牙。权重是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: orbicularis oris (the table at cmu-facs). Realised as both margins rolled in and flattened with the jaw slightly open; the lips do not really fold over the teeth. Weights are assumptions.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：上睑提肌放松、眼轮匝肌睑部（cmu-facs）。这里用上下睑两个睑部通道到闭合线表示；强度按 0–5 连续取值，5 = 完全闭合，而 FACS 和 PSPI 里 AU43 只有有 / 无。
note.en: Muscular basis: relaxation of levator palpebrae superioris, and orbicularis oculi pars palpebralis (cmu-facs). Realised as both palpebral lid channels travelling to the closure line; the intensity is continuous 0–5 here with 5 = fully closed, whereas in FACS and in the PSPI AU43 is only present or absent.
